hero.title: Your Complete Hiking Toolkit
hero.description: Analyze your trails, track your peaks, and visualize every adventure — all in your browser, no data leaves your device.

fitFileViewer.title: FIT File Viewer
fitFileViewer.description: Analyze your Garmin FIT files in the browser

peaksTracker.title: Peaks Tracker
peaksTracker.description: Track and visualize your peak bagging progress

feature-cards.title: Everything You Need on the Trail
feature-cards.description: Powerful browser-based tools designed for hikers, by hikers. No account needed.

peaks-tracker.title: Peaks Tracker
peaks-tracker.description: Log and visualize every summit you've visited. Check the peaks on an interactive map and share the result with your friends.

fit-file-viewer.title: FIT File Viewer
fit-file-viewer.description: Upload your sports watch FIT files and instantly see heart rate zones, elevation profiles, GPS tracks, and detailed activity summaries.

trail-map.title: 3D Trail Map
trail-map.description: Visualize your hiking routes on an interactive 3D map with terrain, satellite imagery, contour lines, and animated track playback.

privacy.title: Built for Hikers Who Care About Privacy
privacy.description: Your GPS data, heart rate, and trail logs never leave your browser. Period.

footer.tagline: Privacy-first hiking tools that run entirely in your browser. No servers, no tracking, no compromise.
footer.copyright: © 2026 TrailKit. Open source under MIT License. Made with ❤️ for the hiking community.

coming-soon.title: More Tools on the Way
coming-soon.description: We're building more privacy-first tools to make every hike better.

trail-planner.title: Trail Planner
trail-planner.description: Plan routes, estimate time, and share trails with friends before you go.

elevation-analyzer.title: Elevation Analyzer
elevation-analyzer.description: Detailed elevation gain/loss charts with gradient analysis for trail difficulty.

weather-overlay.title: Weather Overlay
weather-overlay.description: See historical weather conditions overlaid on your hike timeline and GPS track.

gpx-converter.title: GPX Converter
gpx-converter.description: Convert between FIT, GPX, and KML formats. Merge or split track files effortlessly.

not-found.title: Nothing to see here
not-found.description: Page you are trying to open does not exist. You may have mistyped the address, or the page has been moved to another URL. If you think this is an error contact support.
not-found.back: Take me back to home page
